newsitem.title: USA: US spot MTBE weakens, in line with NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US spot MTBE weakens, in line with NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. spot MTBE prices eased down in quiet trade on Thursday in line with weaker NYMEX gasoline values, but some traders said demand could pick up next week.
NYMEX October gasoline was down 2.21 cents at $60.85 a gallon in late afternoon following strong EIA stock data and news of imports coming in from Europe, traders said.

"There is the possibility that some of those gasoline cargoes will have to be blended (with MTBE as an oxygenate)," said one U.S. trader. "Although a lot people did some buying last week so they could already be covered."
Tight MTBE supply last week is also expected to find some relief in the return from scheduled maintenance on Thursday of Valero Energy Corp's 15,500 bpd plant in Corpus Christi, Texas.
During the turnaround, which began Sept 1, work was also done to expand capacity to 17,000 bpd by early October, said a company official.
In New York Harbor, prompt MTBE was pegged at 86.50 cents, one cent below last week's levels, which had been pressured up by the Iraq crisis.
In the Gulf Coast, spot MTBE was traded Wednesday at 82.75 cents, about 1.25 cents below last week levels.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
